name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abdominal_pain_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a finding of abdominal pain.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a finding of abdominal pain.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a finding of abdominal pain.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a finding of abdominal pain.

name: patient_amylase_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current amylase level in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if no amylase value is available now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured amylase value in U/L if available now.

name: patient_has_undergone_amylase_measurement_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone amylase measurement now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone amylase measurement now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone amylase measurement now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone amylase measurement now.

name: patient_triacylglycerol_lipase_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current lipase level in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if no lipase value is available now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured lipase value in U/L if available now.

name: patient_has_undergone_triacylglycerol_lipase_measurement_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone lipase measurement now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone lipase measurement now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone lipase measurement now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone lipase measurement now.

name: patient_has_undergone_imaging_of_abdomen_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone abdominal imaging now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now.

name: patient_has_undergone_imaging_of_abdomen_now@@demonstrates_changes_of_acute_pancreatitis
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the abdominal imaging performed now demonstrates changes of acute pancreatitis.
when_true: Set to true if the abdominal imaging performed now demonstrates changes of acute pancreatitis.
when_false: Set to false if the abdominal imaging performed now does not demonstrate changes of acute pancreatitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the abdominal imaging performed now demonstrates changes of acute pancreatitis.

name: amylase_upper_limit_of_normal_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the upper limit of normal for amylase in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if the upper limit of normal for amylase is not available or indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the reference upper limit of normal for amylase in U/L for the laboratory used.

name: triacylglycerol_lipase_upper_limit_of_normal_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value representing the upper limit of normal for lipase in units per liter (U/L).
when_unknown: Set to null if the upper limit of normal for lipase is not available or indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the reference upper limit of normal for lipase in U/L for the laboratory used.

name: patient_has_amylase_3x_uln_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's amylase is at least 3 times the upper limit of normal now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone amylase measurement now and the value is at least 3 times the upper limit of normal.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone amylase measurement now and the value is less than 3 times the upper limit of normal, or if no measurement was performed.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone amylase measurement now or the value is indeterminate.

name: patient_has_lipase_3x_uln_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's lipase is at least 3 times the upper limit of normal now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone lipase measurement now and the value is at least 3 times the upper limit of normal.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone lipase measurement now and the value is less than 3 times the upper limit of normal, or if no measurement was performed.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone lipase measurement now or the value is indeterminate.

name: patient_has_elevated_pancreatic_enzymes_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has either amylase or lipase at least 3 times the upper limit of normal now.
when_true: Set to true if either the amylase or lipase is at least 3 times the upper limit of normal now.
when_false: Set to false if neither amylase nor lipase is at least 3 times the upper limit of normal now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether either enzyme is elevated.

name: patient_has_abdominal_imaging_changes_of_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now that demonstrates changes of acute pancreatitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now and the imaging demonstrates changes of acute pancreatitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now and the imaging does not demonstrate changes of acute pancreatitis, or if no imaging was performed.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now or if the imaging demonstrates changes of acute pancreatitis.

name: findings_count
meaning: Integer count of the number of required findings present for acute pancreatitis diagnosis.
when_unknown: Set to null if any of the required findings cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the integer count of the number of findings present (out of 3): (1) characteristic abdominal pain, (2) elevated pancreatic enzymes, (3) imaging changes.

name: time_since_symptom_onset_in_hours
meaning: Numeric value indicating the elapsed time in hours from symptom onset to presentation.
when_unknown: Set to null if the time of symptom onset or the time of presentation is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of hours between the onset of the patient's symptoms and the time the patient presents for care.

name: imrie_score_value_recorded_within_24_hours_of_hospital_presentation_withunit_none
meaning: Numeric value of Imrie's score measured within 24 hours of hospital presentation (unitless).
when_unknown: Set to null if the Imrie's score was not measured within 24 hours of presentation to the hospital, or if the value is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the Imrie's score if it was measured within 24 hours of presentation to the hospital.

name: harmless_acute_pancreatitis_hap_score_value_recorded_within_24_hours_of_hospital_presentation_withunit_none
meaning: Numeric value of Harmless Acute Pancreatitis (HAP) score measured within 24 hours of hospital presentation (unitless).
when_unknown: Set to null if the HAP score was not measured within 24 hours of presentation to the hospital, or if the value is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the Harmless Acute Pancreatitis (HAP) score if it was measured within 24 hours of presentation to the hospital.

name: hematocrit_value_recorded_on_presentation_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's hematocrit (in percent) measured at the time of presentation.
when_unknown: Set to null if the hematocrit value at the time of presentation is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the value of the patient's hematocrit (in percent) measured at the time of presentation.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hematocrit_above_reference_range_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has hemoconcentration (hematocrit above the reference range).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has hemoconcentration (hematocrit above the reference range).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have hemoconcentration (hematocrit above the reference range).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has hemoconcentration (hematocrit above the reference range).

name: patient_lacks_hemoconcentration_on_presentation
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient lacks hemoconcentration (hematocrit above the reference range) at the time of presentation (hematocrit ≤44%).
when_true: Set to true if the patient does not have hemoconcentration (hematocrit above the reference range) at the time of presentation, i.e., hematocrit is not above reference range (≤44%).
when_false: Set to false if the patient does have hemoconcentration (hematocrit above the reference range) at the time of presentation, i.e., hematocrit is above reference range (>44%).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient lacks hemoconcentration at the time of presentation.

name: patient_has_organ_failure_on_first_day_of_presentation
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient had organ failure on the first day of presentation.
when_true: Set to true if the patient had organ failure on the first day of presentation.
when_false: Set to false if the patient did not have organ failure on the first day of presentation.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient had organ failure on the first day of presentation.

name: patient_has_organ_failure_on_first_day_of_presentation@@as_determined_by_atlanta_criteria
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's organ failure on the first day of presentation is determined by the Atlanta criteria.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's organ failure on the first day of presentation is determined by the Atlanta criteria.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's organ failure on the first day of presentation is not determined by the Atlanta criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's organ failure on the first day of presentation is determined by the Atlanta criteria.

name: patient_has_clinical_signs_of_sepsis_now

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have clinical signs of sepsis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has clinical signs of sepsis.

when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone abdominal imaging at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone abdominal imaging at any time in the past.

name: patient_has_undergone_imaging_of_abdomen_inthehistory@@demonstrates_dilated_pancreatic_duct

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the abdominal imaging demonstrated pancreatic calcifications.

name: international_normalized_ratio_value_recorded_now_withunit_ratio
meaning: Numeric value for the patient's most recent INR measured now, in units of ratio.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's INR value measured now is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's most recent INR value measured now, in units of ratio.

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a blood coagulation disorder (coagulopathy).
